verdict.rationale: Docusign ships AI features such as Iris, AI-assisted review chat and ready-to-deploy agents, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Docusign acting as an MCP server that Claude, Gemini CLI and others connect to. There is no evidence that Docusign itself can connect to or use third-party MCP servers' tools.
